description: Fixed taxonomy of AI-research themes used to tag every article during Claude analysis. Closed-vocabulary tagging keeps the analytics dashboard's charts comparable across time. Add new themes here (with stable ids — never rename existing ids) and run a backfill to retag historical articles.

themes.label: Biomedical AI
themes.description: AI applied to medicine, drug discovery, diagnostics, genomics, clinical trials, biology.

themes.label: Neuroscience & BCI
themes.description: Brain-computer interfaces, computational neuroscience, AI-decoded neural signals.

themes.label: Robotics
themes.description: Robots, mechatronics, embodied AI, drones, prosthetics, manipulation, mobility.

themes.label: Autonomous Vehicles
themes.description: Self-driving cars, drones with autonomy, autonomous shipping, navigation systems.

themes.label: NLP & LLMs
themes.description: Large language models, chatbots, machine translation, text understanding, retrieval-augmented generation.

themes.label: Computer Vision
themes.description: Image and video understanding, object detection, segmentation, medical imaging analysis.

themes.label: Generative AI
themes.description: Image, audio, video, or 3D generation; diffusion models; creative AI; deepfakes.

themes.label: AI Ethics & Fairness
themes.description: Bias, fairness, accountability, responsible AI, sociotechnical critiques, equity.

themes.label: AI Safety & Alignment
themes.description: Alignment, red-teaming, model robustness, adversarial attacks, content safety.

themes.label: AI Policy & Governance
themes.description: Regulation, government policy, AI in national security/defense, export controls, legal frameworks.

themes.label: Climate & Environment
themes.description: Climate modeling, weather, environmental monitoring, sustainability, conservation, ocean/forest science.

themes.label: Agriculture & Food
themes.description: Precision agriculture, crop modeling, food systems, agricultural security.

themes.label: AI in Education
themes.description: AI for teaching and learning, ChatGPT-in-classroom, academic-integrity policies, ed-tech.

themes.label: Materials & Chemistry
themes.description: AI-driven materials discovery, computational chemistry, energy materials, novel compounds.

themes.label: Physics & Astronomy
themes.description: AI applied to physics, astronomy, particle physics, cosmology, scientific simulation.

themes.label: HPC & AI Systems
themes.description: Supercomputing, AI infrastructure, GPU/TPU clusters, distributed training, AI hardware/chips, thermodynamic or neuromorphic computing.

themes.label: AI & Cybersecurity
themes.description: AI for cybersecurity, threat detection, AI-assisted defense or attack, vulnerability discovery.

themes.label: Partnerships & Industry
themes.description: Industry-academia collaborations, MOUs, cloud-provider partnerships, joint research centers.

themes.label: Funding & Awards
themes.description: Grants, awards, named professorships, philanthropic gifts, federal funding announcements.

themes.label: Workforce & Training
themes.description: AI workforce development, micro-credentials, professional training, AI literacy initiatives.

themes.label: Explainable AI
themes.description: Interpretability, model explanation, mechanistic understanding, transparency tools.

themes.label: General / Other
themes.description: AI news that doesn't fit any specific theme above (broad announcements, events, opinion pieces).
